name: Fenrir (Paper Trading)
description: Runs paper trades against live markets, defaulting to the NSE but able to switch to NASDAQ, adjusting session hours, currency, the book and the tradable universe to match. Ships with a God of War persona by default, which can be changed; no real money is involved.

official.title: Fenrir by Shantanu
